title: Ionic and covalent bonding
basic_overview: Ionic solids are dominated by electrostatic lattice interactions; covalent bonds arise from shared electron density and orbital overlap.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Assess charge, size, polarisation and orbital overlap.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Compare electronegativity. 2. Assess lattice stabilisation if ionic. 3. Assess overlap if covalent. 4. Apply polarisation for mixed character.
extra_info_content.factors: Small/high-charge cations and large anions increase covalent character (Fajans-type reasoning).
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
